deadline.value: February 15, 2027 for full admission and Graduate Assistantship consideration (later applications are reviewed on a rolling basis until positions fill).
deadline.quote: The deadline for applying for a Graduate Assistantship is February 15. Application materials received after February 15 are considered on a rolling basis until all positions are filled.

also.quote: Applications for financial support from the Department of Mathematics should be completed by February 15 to be guaranteed full consideration for funding for the following academic year.

gre_general.value: Official General GRE scores are required (ETS institution code 1106, department code 0703).
gre_general.quote: Applicants must arrange for ETS to send an official copy of the general GRE scores.

gre_subject.value: GRE Mathematics Subject Test requirement is not stated (only general GRE scores are listed in admissions requirements).

supervisor.value: Not stated in Mathematical Sciences Ph.D. admission requirements.

funding.value: Graduate Teaching Assistantships (and limited Research Assistantships) are awarded competitively, covering a stipend plus a tuition waiver for 20 academic-year credit hours and up to 4 summer credit hours (renewable up to 7 years for Ph.D. students).
funding.quote: Both admission to the program and awards of Graduate Assistantships are competitive, with evaluation based on the nature of previous coursework, grades, general GRE scores, and letters of recommendation.

also.quote: Tuition waiver for 20 credit hours at on-campus rates for the academic year of hire and up to four credit hours for the subsequent summer session.

entry_route.value: Open to applicants with a bachelor's degree (20 semester hours of math including Multivariate Calculus, Abstract Algebra, and Advanced Calculus; 75 graduate credits beyond the bachelor's) or an equivalent master's degree.
entry_route.quote: Applicants with a Bachelor's degree must have successfully completed 20 semester hours of mathematics including Multivariate Calculus (equivalent to MTH 233), Abstract Algebra (equivalent to MTH 523), and Advanced Calculus (equivalent to MTH 532). | Successful completion of the Ph.D., including coursework, internship, and dissertation, requires a minimum of 75 semester hours of graduate work beyond the bachelor's degree.

notes: 75-credit-hour Ph.D. in Mathematical Sciences with Mathematics and Collegiate Mathematics Education concentrations plus teaching internship.
name: Ph.D. in Mathematical Sciences
